title: Grateful Dead Live at Manor Downs on 1982-07-31
lineage: SRCS > WAV > Vegas 5 (matrix) > WAV > CD Wave > FLAC 16 (level 8)

ai_review.summary: Superb matrix mix captures a high‑energy 1982 performance with smoking Scarlet > Fire, Estimated, Eyes and Morning Dew.
ai_review.review: The recording is a crystal‑clear matrix blend that lets every instrument shine, while the band delivers an electrifying show—tight first‑set classics give way to a second set that erupts on Scarlet > Fire, Estimated, Eyes, Uncle/Truckin' and a sublime Morning Dew. Reviewers rave about Jerry’s soaring vocals and tone, Bob’s articulate rhythm work, and the overall fire‑cracker energy of the night.

ai_rating.rationale: Consistently high review scores (11 × 5‑star, 3 × 4‑star) and detailed praise for both the show’s energy and the matrix recording’s clarity justify a top‑tier rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Reviewers describe the mix as precise, cleanly separated, and superbly balanced—often likened to an Owsley‑style front‑of‑house sound. Early vocals are noted as slightly washed out, but overall clarity is outstanding.

show_quality.setlist_flow: A solid first set of early‑80s staples builds momentum, then the second set launches into fire‑starter jams with seamless transitions and high‑octane improvisation.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Praised for scorching guitar tone, soaring vocals (especially on Morning Dew) and overall musical leadership.
band_member_comments.Bob: Weir’s rhythm work is highlighted as clear and easy to follow; his playing receives specific commendation.
band_member_comments.Drums: Drummers receive glowing remarks for clarity, punch, and the space‑themed improvisations.
